sapere.gloss: to know (a fact or how to)

Followed directly by an infinitive (sai giocare?, 'do you know how to play?').

examples.trans: Do you know how to play foosball?

meanings.note: Interrogative and relative adverb of place; elides to dov' before è.

Absolute superlative (-issimo) of grande.
